caption: The video captures a runner moving along a sunlit beach, seen from behind and slightly to one side. The legs cycle continuously through a running gait. The two feet alternate between planted contact and lifted swing, so the stride is already underway on the first frame and continues past the last. A dark shadow lies on the dry sand to the runner's left, shifting in step with each footfall. Turquoise water and white breaking waves roll along the shoreline behind. The framing widens as the clip proceeds. It opens from a tight crop of the black shorts and red-and-yellow shoes to a fuller view that takes in the coral long-sleeve top, the swinging arms, and, near the final frames, the base of the neck. The background composition drifts in step with this change: the rocky headland on the right becomes more fully visible while the sea and horizon sink lower in the frame, opening more sky above. The runner's stride never pauses, and waves keep breaking along the waterline throughout.
